Usage: winix [options] [command [tool...]]

Install, update, and manage the Winix CLI tool suite.

Options:
  --dry-run                    Show commands that would be run without executing them
  --project                    Write into committed project files (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) instead of user/global agent config (agents only)
  --claude                     Force the Claude home/file even when absent: user scope → ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; --project → include CLAUDE.md (agents only)
  --codex                      Force the Codex user home (~/.codex/AGENTS.md) even when absent (agents user scope only)
  --via PM                     Package manager to use: winget, scoop, brew, dotnet
  --path DIR                   Project directory for --project (agents only; default: current directory)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  winix install                 Install all Winix tools using the default package manager
  winix install timeit squeeze  Install specific tools
  winix install --via scoop     Install all tools via Scoop
  winix update                  Update all installed Winix tools
  winix uninstall               Remove all Winix tools
  winix list                    List all tools and their install status
  winix status                  Show a summary of installed tools
  winix install --dry-run       Preview what would be installed
  winix agents init             Write the Winix pointer into your user agent config (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md)
  winix agents init --project   Write a conditional pointer into this repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (for teams standardized on Winix)
  winix agents status           Report whether your user agent config carries a current pointer (exit 1 if not)
 
[truncated]
